name: Alsip (United States)
description: Horizontal bicolour of white and red, the words ALSIP ILLINOIS in red across the top and the village arms in yellow, red and white at the centre.
history: Alsip is a village in Cook County, Illinois. The flag was adopted in 1965 (the design by Nancy O'Connor won a village contest and was first flown on 4 July 1965, according to Flags of the World quoting the village history).

features.role: village arms in yellow, red and white
